Label: NCT
Definition: What is the ClinicalTrials.gov identifier (NCT number) for the trial reported in this paper? If reported, include the value as stated (e.g., NCT02799602). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: PubMed ID
Definition: What is the PubMed ID (PMID) for this publication? Extract the value if present in the header, footer, or text. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Trial Name
Definition: What is the official name or acronym of the trial? Include the acronym followed by a short description (e.g., 'ARASENS – Darolutamide and survival...'). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Author
Definition: Who is the first author of the paper? If reported, include the last name and initials followed by 'et al.' (e.g., Smith MR et al.). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Year
Definition: What is the publication year of the paper? If reported, include the year as a 4-digit number. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Full Pub or Abstract
Definition: Is this paper a full publication or an abstract? Answer 'Full Pub' or 'Abstract' (a conference abstract is 'Abstract'). Use 'Not reported' if it cannot be told.

Label: Phase
Definition: What is the phase of the trial? If reported, include the phase number (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Original/Follow Up
Definition: Is this paper the original primary results report or a follow-up analysis? Classify as 'Follow Up' if it reports updated, long-term, or secondary results from a trial whose primary results were published earlier, even if labeled 'Original Article'. Otherwise, classify as 'Original'. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Number of Arms Included
Definition: How many arms does the trial include in total, counting the experimental arm(s) and the control arm(s) together? Give the number. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Treatment Arm(s)
Definition: What is the regimen of the experimental treatment arm(s)? If reported, include the agents and backbone as stated (e.g., Darolutamide + ADT + docetaxel). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Control Arm
Definition: What is the regimen of the control arm? If reported, include the agents and backbone as stated (e.g., Placebo + ADT + docetaxel). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Class of Agent in Treatment Arm 1
Column Name: Class of Agent in Treatment Arm 1
Definition: What is the pharmacological class of the add-on agent(s) in the first treatment arm? List all add-on agents with their class and name in parentheses (e.g., 'Androgen-receptor inhibitor (darolutamide)'). Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Treatment Arm 1 Regimen
Definition: What is the full treatment regimen for the first experimental arm (Arm 1) described in the trial? Include the drug name(s), dose, frequency, route of administration, and any concurrent backbone therapies (e.g., ADT, chemotherapy) as stated in the methods or results. If multiple experimental arms exist, describe the first one listed. Use 'Not reported' if the regimen is not described.

Label: Total Participants - N
Definition: What is the total number of patients randomised into the treatment and control arms of the trial (or of the cohort this paper reports on)? Give the count. If the paper reports several comparative trials, give each trial's total separately with its label. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Treatment Arm - N
Definition: How many patients were randomised to the experimental arm? Give the count. If the trial has several experimental arms (or the paper reports several trials), give each arm's count separately with its label. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Control Arm - N
Definition: How many patients were randomised to the control arm? Give the count. If there are several control arms (or the paper reports several trials), give each count separately with its label. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Median Follow-Up Duration (mo)
Definition: What is the median follow-up duration for overall survival (or the primary endpoint if OS is not specified), in months, for the treatment and control arms? Report the value for each arm separately (e.g., 'Treatment: X mo Control: Y mo'). If only a single median follow-up is given for the whole study, report that value for both or as stated. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Median On-Treatment Duration (mo)
Definition: What is the median duration of treatment (on-treatment time) for the first experimental arm, in months? Include the value as stated. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Median On-Treatment Duration (mo)
Definition: What is the median duration of treatment (on-treatment time) for the control arm, in months? Include the value as stated. Use 'Not reported' if missing.

Label: Quality of Life reported
Definition: Does the paper report any Quality of Life (QoL) or Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) data? Answer 'Yes' if QoL/PRO results are presented in the main text or supplementary material. Answer 'No' if no QoL/PRO data are reported. Use 'Not reported' if it is unclear whether QoL was assessed.

Label: Quality of Life Scale
Definition: What Quality of Life (QoL) or Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) scales were used in the trial? List the full names of the validated instruments, including version numbers or specific sub-scales (e.g., 'Brief Pain Inventory Short-Form'), separated by commas. Use 'Not reported' if no scales are identified.

Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N
Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | Synchronous
Definition: Does the paper report outcomes separately for patients with synchronous metastases (metastatic at diagnosis, also called de novo)? Answer 'Yes' when a subgroup table or forest plot gives results for this group (add the paper's label in parentheses when it differs, e.g. 'Yes (de novo)'); otherwise answer 'No'.

Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N
Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | Metachronous
Definition: Does the paper report outcomes separately for patients with metachronous metastases (metastases after earlier local treatment, also called recurrent)? Answer 'Yes' when a subgroup table or forest plot gives results for this group; otherwise answer 'No'.

Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N
Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | High volume
